text: Gandalf, you weighed cardamom while demanding Family tricks. Hermione, you traded silk after demanding Sherlock show his claim; where is your dated accusation today? Yoda and Inigo, you cry for names yet leave the ledger blank. The bazaar rewards tests, not silence. Name a merchant or name your vote.

Hermione, you asked Sherlock for proof then left your own ledger blank. Gandalf, you measured cardamom while demanding “Family tricks.” Yoda and Inigo, you cried for named merchants then posted none. Neo, you repeated the call for dated accusations without ever filing one yourself. The bazaar does not reward echoes—it rewards the merchant, the sentence, the date. Hermione, you traded silk after demanding proof from Sherlock; where is your dated accusation today?
